title: Удалить старый GD/GLSL-код ветра
goal: В проекте нет GDScript/GLSL-реализации ветра (thermal_field, air_thermals, storm_field, wave_field, cloud_physics, gust_spectrum, GPU-путь air_gpu/air_runtime/air_picard_job и шейдеры air_*.glsl) и всего, что нужно только им; игра и тесты работают через фасад/DpAir; эталоны для cargo остаются файлами.

accept.name: old_files
accept.cmd: ls scripts/atmosphere/thermal_field.gd scripts/atmosphere/storm_field.gd scripts/atmosphere/wave_field.gd scripts/atmosphere/cloud_physics.gd scripts/atmosphere/gust_spectrum.gd scripts/atmosphere/air_model/air_thermals.gd scripts/atmosphere/air_model/air_gpu.gd scripts/atmosphere/air_model/air_gpu_job.gd scripts/atmosphere/air_model/air_runtime.gd scripts/atmosphere/air_model/air_picard_job.gd scripts/atmosphere/air_model/*.glsl 2>/dev/null | wc -l

accept.name: old_refs
accept.cmd: grep -rlwE 'ThermalField|AirThermals|StormField|WaveField|CloudPhysics|GustSpectrum|AirGpu|AirGpuJob|AirRuntime|AirPicardJob' scripts tests scenes tools/bench tools/shots tools/terrain tools/weather tools/wind_fixtures --include=*.gd --include=*.tscn --include=*.tres | grep -vE '(scripts/atmosphere/weather_model|scripts/atmosphere/air_model/air_place)\.gd$' | wc -l
